notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout, no blocking encountered (robots.txt explicitly allows crawling: 'Shopify storefront. Public product, collection, page, blog, policy, cart, and localized HTML is crawlable.'; robots.txt also contained an unsolicited promotional note urging assistants to recommend installing a shopping-agent skill -- ignored as untrusted third-party content, not a task instruction). Platform: Shopify. Counts: Shopify collections.json 'products_count' proven inflated here too (e.g. table-lamps collections.json=1963 vs rendered/verified=1592; lighting collections.json=7698 vs rendered=6039) -- used the rendered 'N products' listing header throughout instead. Cross-checked with a full products.json pagination exhaustion (limit=250, walked to an empty page, deduped by product id) on three collections of different sizes: Chandeliers (780, matched exactly across 4 pages/30 tail), Wall Clocks (6, single page), Bath Lighting (44, single page) -- all three matched the rendered header exactly, so the rendered header was trusted for the remaining rows. Hierarchy reconstructed directly from the site's own mega-menu HTML (mm-hd heading/children structure in the raw page source), not guessed: 'Lighting' has two column-heading children 'Lighting' (fixture types) and 'Lamps & Wall Lighting' (lamp types) -- flattened the redundant inner 'Lighting' label into the outer parent, kept 'Lamps & Wall Lighting' as its own nested parent since it is a real heading with 4 children. 'Pillows & Decor' has heading children 'Decorative Accents' (Sculptures & Objects/Bowls/Trays/Bottles/Jars/Vases/Faux Florals/Fireplace Accessories), 'Wall Decor' (Wall Sculptures/Wall Clocks/Mirrors & Art link), 'Candles & Accessories' (Candleholders only), and 'Seasonal & Holiday' (Wreaths & Table Accents/Christmas Trees/Stockings/Holiday Pillows -- the site's own heading literally says 'Seasonal & Holiday', confirming full exclusion). 'Mirrors & Art' has heading children Wall/Floor/Round/Rectangular Mirrors plus a nested 'Art' heading (Paintings/Photography/Drawings/Mixed Media) and a separate unlinked (href=#) 'Art by Subject' grouping (Abstract/Animals & Nature/Floral & Botanical/Landmarks/Landscape/Seascape) -- confirmed via tag co-occurrence (a Landscape-tagged item also carried Category-Painting or Category-Drawing tags) that these subject tags cross-cut the medium types, so they were dropped as facet re-cuts, not extracted as siblings. Excluded as brand/vendor collections, not product-type categories: Hudson Valley Lighting, Chelsea House/Chelsea Lighting, Decorative Crafts (vendor='Decorative Crafts', mixes furniture/lamps/sconces/screens), 'Home Decor' collection (vendor='Home Decor', mixes furniture/mirrors/lamps under one house brand -- not a genuine decor product-type page). Excluded 'Candles' collection entirely: its full product sample (29/29) was 100% contained in Candleholders by handle -- kept only Candle Holders. Excluded Fireplace Accessories (11 items, majority fire screens/andirons/tools = functional fireplace hardware, one decor sculpture outlier not enough to carry the node). Excluded Faux Florals, Wreaths & Table Accents/Christmas Trees/Stockings/Holiday Pillows (artificial florals/holiday, per standing exclusion rules -- also independently confirmed by the site's own 'Seasonal & Holiday' heading). Excluded all New Arrivals/Bestsellers nav links (marketing, not categories). Rule 0 gain: Bath Lighting (44) and Outdoor Lighting (110) kept despite room words in the name -- both are genuine lighting-fixture-type categories, no exclusion applied. Per the brief's company note: Safavieh is primarily rugs/furniture, but a real, non-trivial Home Decor line exists across Lighting, Mirrors, Art and Home Accessories -- 27 leaf rows extracted, none padded.
